name: Elemental HERO Neos Alius
ability:

name: Musto, Oracle of Gusto
ability: Once per turn: You can target 1 "Gusto" monster in your Graveyard and 1 face-up monster on the field; shuffle the first target into the Deck, and if you do, negate the second target's effects until the End Phase.
